extension-build.description: Builds the Blender extension archives the project's blender_manifest.toml declares; a project holding pyproject.toml builds from a staged copy that bundles its locked registry dependencies as wheels for the running Blender and its local dependencies as subpackages

package.description: Packs the Adobe UXP plugin or CEP extension the project's other builds wrote, else its source folder: a .ccx zip for a manifest.json, a ZXPSignCmd-signed .zxp for a CSXS/manifest.xml

install.description: Installs each host package the project's build wrote for this platform, in the configuration each build task ran in, through the host's own installer

release-publish.description: Attaches each host package the project's build wrote to its GitHub release and publishes it to its host's package server, skipping distributions the server holds and a project nx release left unversioned

unreal-build.description: Builds a .uproject's editor target through UnrealBuildTool, or packages a .uplugin through AutomationTool's BuildPlugin once per engine its hosts name and archives each package

place.description: Places the unpacked plug-in the project's builds wrote into the host's per-user plug-in folder in one exchange, registers a UXP plug-in in its host's registry file, and signs a CEP extension before placing it
